results.title: Dirty Dancing
results.overview: Spending the summer at a Catskills resort with her family, Frances "Baby" Houseman falls in love with the camp's dance instructor, Johnny Castle, and nothing is ever the same for anyone in the Houseman family.

results.title: 47 Meters Down
results.overview: Two sisters on Mexican vacation are trapped in a shark observation cage at the bottom of the ocean, with oxygen running low and great whites circling nearby, they have less than an hour of air left to figure out how to get to the surface.

results.title: Churchill
results.overview: A ticking-clock thriller following Winston Churchill in the 24 hours before D-Day.

results.title: Baywatch
results.overview: Devoted lifeguard Mitch Buchannon butts heads with a brash new recruit. Together, they uncover a local criminal plot that threatens the future of the Bay.

results.title: The Man with the Iron Heart
results.original_title: The Man with the Iron Heart
results.overview: With the Third Reich at its peak in 1942, the Czech resistance in London plans the most ambitious military operation of WWII –  Anthropoid. Two young recruits are sent to Prague to assassinate the most ruthless Nazi leader – Reinhard Heydrich, head of the Reich Security Main Office, the Gestapo and the architect of the Final Solution.

results.title: Abducted in Plain Sight
results.overview: A family falls prey to the manipulative charms of a neighbor, who abducts their adolescent daughter. Twice.

results.title: Drone
results.overview: Ideologies collide with fatal results when a military drone contractor meets an enigmatic Pakistani businessman.

results.title: War Machine
results.overview: A rock star general bent on winning the “impossible” war in Afghanistan takes us inside the complex machinery of modern war. Inspired by the true story of General Stanley McChrystal.

results.title: Black Butterfly
results.overview: Paul is a down-on-his-luck screenwriter who picks up a drifter and offers him a place to stay. However, when the deranged stranger takes Paul hostage and forces him to write, their unhinged relationship brings buried secrets to light.

results.title: Buster's Mal Heart
results.overview: An eccentric mountain man on the run from the local sheriff recalls the mysterious events that brought him to his present fugitive state.

results.title: Michael Jackson: Searching for Neverland
results.overview: Based on the best-selling book, Remember the Time: Protecting Michael Jackson in His Final Days, and told through the eyes of Jackson's trusted bodyguards, Bill Whitfield and Javon Beard. The movie will reveal firsthand the devotion Michael Jackson had to his children, and the hidden drama that took place during the last two years of his life.

results.title: Sarah Silverman: A Speck of Dust
results.original_title: Sarah Silverman: A Speck of Dust
results.overview: In her first comedy special post-health scare, Sarah Silverman shares a mix of fun facts, sad truths and yeah-she-just-went-there moments.

results.title: Wonder Woman
results.overview: An Amazon princess comes to the world of Man in the grips of the First World War to confront the forces of evil and bring an end to human conflict.

results.title: In a Heartbeat
results.overview: A closeted boy runs the risk of being outed by his own heart after it pops out of his chest to chase down the boy of his dreams.

results.title: Kill Switch
results.overview: A pilot battles to save his family and the planet after an experiment for unlimited energy goes wrong.

results.title: Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie
results.original_title: Captain Underpants: The First Epic Movie
results.overview: Based on the bestselling book series, this outrageous comedy tells the story of George and Harold,  two overly imaginative pranksters who hypnotize their principal into thinking he’s an enthusiastic, yet dimwitted, superhero named Captain Underpants.

results.title: Stasis
results.overview: After a night out of partying and left behind by her friends, Ava wakes up and sneaks back home only to find that she's already safe in bed. But that's not Ava - it's someone who looks just like her. A time-traveling fugitive has stolen Ava's body, her identity, and her life. What's more -- she's not alone. There are others, hiding in the past, secretly living among us, plotting to alter the future. Without her body, Ava is a virtual ghost, silent and invisible to the world. And, so far as she knows, she's the only one who can stop them and put the timeline back on course.

results.title: The Recall
results.overview: When five friends vacation at a remote lake house, they expect nothing less then a good time, unaware that Earth is under attack by an alien invasion and mass-abductions.

results.title: Band Aid
results.overview: A couple who can't stop fighting embark on a last-ditch effort to save their marriage: turning their fights into songs and starting a band.

results.title: The Exception
results.overview: Nothing is as it seems in this riveting World War 2 thriller as a wary soldier goes to investigate a mysterious German monarch at his secluded mansion, leading him into a web of deceit and a dangerous love affair with a local Jewish woman.
